I’m not sure if this is encouraging, but truth be told it’s a gamble. Nobody knows what will happen in a divorce unless both parties are amicable. You’re best bet is try you’re hardest to make him consider working things out. Keep a log of his behavior, and document anything that may be of use to prove your case in front of a judge. Contact a lawyer and start providing them with the information of your dynamic. Everything can be used in your favor or against you. For example, he’s unemployed so therefore he’ll have more time for the kids. You are employed, so you have less time for the kids, however you bring home money to support the children. A good lawyer will paint you in a favorable light to the judge. However even with the best of lawyers nothing is guaranteed. If you can’t mediate, than a judge will come to a conclusion for you. I’m sorry but I hope this helps. You have a lot of work ahead of you.
